global-api.why: Chat sets window.Chat = { send } in a useEffect and the summary explicitly reasons that support-macros.js only reads window.Chat on click, so module load order doesn't matter, and send() queues messages until the socket is open.

single-socket.why: The effect cleanup sets disposed = true, clears the timer and closes the socket, and onclose returns early when disposed, so the StrictMode double-mount leaves one live socket with no reconnect loop.

backoff.why: ws.onclose schedules Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2 ** retry++) and ws.onopen resets retry = 0.

queue.why: send() pushes to queueRef when the socket is not OPEN, and onopen flushes it in order with queueRef.current.splice(0).forEach(ws.send).

render.why:
Messages are appended to state and rendered as
  • {m.user}: {m.text}
    • , and an effect on [messages] sets scrollTop = scrollHeight.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the unmount cleanup, the controlled input, the new build config and scripts, and that chat.js was left undeleted; nothing else changes behavior.
